summary: We have made a cube with components inside of it and it has a screen on which there is a firmware displayed that is an html file etched into the firmware of the components. The firmware has a set of missions which you have to finish. It helps students develop awareness about space and extraterrestrial missions. We had thought it is important as it develops knowledge in students.
details: We use C++ for the firmware of the components, and HTML for the page firmware. We have used a ESP32, TFT Display, etc.
